children: Safran confirmed its full-year outlook after third-quarter revenue climbed on double-digit growth across its propulsion and equipment and defense units.

The French aerospace-industry supplier said Friday that revenue for the period rose nearly 15% to 9 billion euros, equivalent to $10.09 billion. Its propulsion unit posted a roughly 13% organic rise in revenue, and its equipment and defense division logged nearly 16% growth.

The company backed its full-year guidance of mid-teens revenue growth, a recurring operating income of 6.4 billion euros to 6.5 billion euros and free cash flow of 4.7 billion euros to 4.9 billion euros.
